responses.text: {Player in NCR gear} {suspicious} You're not part of this post as far as I know. What do you want?
{Player not in NCR gear} {suspicious} This is a military outpost. Why are you here?
{confused} "High casualties?" We've had one broken ankle, but nobody at this post has died.

topics.prompt: Sgt. Reyes sent me - she's curious about the high casualties at this station.

responses.text: Any injury, illness, or death gets radioed to Ranger HQ at Camp Golf.
Chief Hanlon and his aides compile the reports and assign reinforcements as needed, and they're not needed here.
Do a fucking headcount, then. Everybody's right where they're supposed to be.

topics.prompt: Maybe you're lying to keep morale up.

responses.text: Ranger Station Alpha used to be the frontline outpost for NCR. When we moved onto the Dam, this station has fallen into more a support role.
There are other Ranger posts around. Reyes might have mixed up the report.

topics.prompt: How could Reyes have been wrong?

responses.text: Reyes got the numbers wrong - not much more to it than that.
Have you ever heard the story of the bomber that crashed into the lake before the War? Supposedly it's mostly intact, even after all that time.
For about ten years now. Toughest training I've ever done, and was the proudest day of my life when I got my Ranger badge.
Did you know that the first battle at Hoover Dam was won because of the Rangers? Legion had the numbers, but we had the skill.
